title: VRAM claim: direct compact 2D Gaussians to 3D Gaussians without Beam
question: What peak reconstruction-process memory, runtime, and compact-domain fidelity does a fully image-free 2D-Gaussian to 3D-Gaussian pipeline achieve without Beam Fusion?
hypothesis: At a matched Beam-independent initialization and hardware environment, direct compact reconstruction uses materially less peak CUDA memory than image-supervised 3DGS while retaining useful held-out compact-field fidelity.
claim_boundary: Development evidence for the post-2D-fit reconstruction process only. It excludes capture, RGB-to-2D fitting, cross-process RGB evaluation, generalization beyond the named scenes, and any Original-3DGS claim.

stages.label: Load compact fields
stages.purpose: Load integrity-checked 2D Gaussian bundles and calibrated cameras without any image-capable loader.

stages.label: Direct compact initialization
stages.purpose: Construct a bounded 3D initialization directly from compact fields with compact carve; fusion lineage and repair are unavailable.

stages.label: Direct compact optimization
stages.purpose: Optimize the direct compact initialization against sampled 2D Gaussian fields under a separately frozen schedule.

stages.label: Save standard 3D Gaussians
stages.purpose: Write the final standard Gaussians3D model and compact-domain evaluation without an RGB handover.

comparators.label: RGB-trained 3DGS resource receipt
comparators.purpose: A cross-task paired resource contrast only; the RGB process never executes inside this arm.

comparators.label: Frozen compact input bytes
comparators.purpose: Report storage entering the reconstruction boundary without claiming capture-to-model bandwidth.

primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out compact area risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Compact reconstruction input size
primary_metrics.aggregation: sum of sealed calibration and 2D Gaussian bundle bytes per scene

resource_protocol.scope: fresh reconstruction-only process from compact manifest open through final PLY save; RGB-to-2D fitting and any RGB evaluator are excluded
resource_protocol.aggregation: paired median on one idle named GPU; retain every raw repeat and report min/max

blockers: Implement the task-specific runner around CompactCarveInitializer and CompactTrainer with process-level no-image and no-Beam guards plus the shared report producer.
Freeze the exact Beam-independent compact-carve initialization, optimizer iteration/chunk settings, topology policy, and stopping rule after a mechanism-only pilot, before changing status to ready.
Freeze the target GPU, idle threshold, NVML sampling interval, paired VRAM effect floor, and failure policy.
Add at least one outcome-unseen scene before promoting a general or confirmatory VRAM claim.
